title: Layer 2 Multilanguage Video and Blog Content
tagline: Youtube videos and dev.to blog posts about Scroll zkRollup Testnet in Spanish, English and French
description:
During the Hackathon we met the Scroll team and got whitelisted on the Scroll Testnet. So we decided to do Video and Blog content about this network that we really liked. We did 3 videos and blogposts 3 laungues (Spanish, English and French).
Our mission is to give devs the tools needed for them to create dapps and projects on Web 3. That's why we created Filosofía Código, our youtube channel. We want to continue learning and sharing knowledge.
how_its_made: We made this simplest DApp possible so onboarding its easier for devs. We used Remix, HTML, JS vanilla, web3.js and all the Scroll L1 and L2 enpoints. Scroll is very similar to any L1 or optimistic rollups because is easy to integrate so it should be easy for experienced devs to use Scroll. However we explain all the process in case a new dev wants to test Scroll.
